apps.localizedDescription: An independently maintained iOS/iPadOS fork of NeoStation with a gamepad-friendly, console-style game library and embedded Libretro cores, MeloNX, Dolphin, ARMSX2 and RPCS3 runtimes, JIT workflows and support for user-supplied firmware, keys and BIOS.

versions.localizedDescription:
## RewindBox iOS — fix 0.0.9 (Build 530)

This hotfix addresses the identified MeloNX crash path on iOS: Vulkan returned ErrorFeatureNotPresent during direct host-memory buffer import after a Nintendo Switch game began rendering. The embedded engine now avoids that unsupported import on iOS and uses its existing GPU buffer/readback fallback.

- Rebuilt and source-verified embedded MeloNX NativeAOT engine.
- Existing RPCS3 Core and other supported embedded emulators retained.
- Ad-hoc signed for re-signing with SideStore/AltStore.
- Automated native/iOS-simulator and packaging checks passed.

Please test gameplay stability on a physical iPhone. The fix addresses the observed Vulkan API failure, but a successful long game session has not yet been independently verified.

Version note: IPA build number 530; internal app version remains 0.0.8 because this targeted hotfix retains the previously validated application metadata. The release title is fix 0.0.9.

Source: RewindBox development branch merged into main. No personal firmware, Switch keys or game files are bundled.
